design_summary.title: Assignment 8 - Workflow (WF) Strategy Test Design
design_summary.status: FROZEN DESIGN ONLY - no implementation inspection and no pytest generation or execution
design_summary.method: Independently derived from the Problem Statement and authoritative workflow state-transition tables. Basis workflows and composites share test IDs when they describe the same path.
ambiguities: The Problem Statement prohibits registration requests outside an open window but does not state the resulting error, status, or record behavior.
Rebate date modification is conditional on institution policy; the permitted modification rules are not specified.
Rebate validation guards are stated, but the result of submissions violating minimum duration, lead time, overlap, or the required explanation is unspecified.
The vacation workflow specifies explicit responses before the deadline and a default at the deadline, but does not define the result of an explicit response submitted exactly at the deadline.
The special-food decision period is institution-defined; the Problem Statement notes 12 hours as intended, not authoritative. The exact timeout and behavior of too-late submissions are not defined.
Monthly billing inputs are listed, but no concrete rates, charge values, rebate calculation details, or rounding rules are supplied for asserting a numeric bill.
scope_notes: Role assignment, menu publication, announcement publication, feedback, and reporting are explicitly outside the connected workflows in the Workflow Specifications; they are not added as workflows.
Email expectations are limited to MMS triggering system-generated notifications described in the Problem Statement; external delivery is out of scope.
Payment collection, accounting settlement, payroll, procurement, inventory, and email infrastructure are outside MMS scope.

test_cases.workflow_id_name: BW-MMS-01 Registration — Approved; CW-MMS-01 Registration Request Lifecycle
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: Registration Window Not Open -> Registration Window Open -> Registration Request Pending -> Registration Request Approved / Student Registered
test_cases.test_objective: Verify the valid registration path and approval outcome.
preconditions: A student is eligible to submit a registration request.
No registration window is currently open.

test_data.window_information: Sufficient information to open the window, as required by the specification.

steps_or_api_action: Mess Caretaker opens the registration window.
Student submits a valid request while the window is open.
Mess Caretaker approves the pending request.
expected_result: The window becomes open, the request becomes Pending, and approval results in Approved / Student Registered.
MMS records request history and triggers the student email notifications for submission and decision.
specification_reference: Problem Statement §3.3.1 Registration Management
Workflow Specifications BW-MMS-01 STT rows 1-3; CW-MMS-01 STT rows 1-3

test_cases.workflow_id_name: BW-MMS-02 Registration — Rejected; CW-MMS-01 Registration Request Lifecycle
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: Registration Window Not Open -> Registration Window Open -> Registration Request Pending -> Registration Request Rejected
test_cases.test_objective: Verify the valid registration path when the Caretaker rejects the pending request.
preconditions: A registration window is open.
A valid student registration request can be submitted.
steps_or_api_action: Student submits a valid request while the registration window is open.
Mess Caretaker rejects the pending request.
expected_result: The request progresses to Pending and then Rejected; the student is not registered by this outcome.
MMS records request history and triggers the student email notifications for submission and decision.
specification_reference: Problem Statement §3.3.1 Registration Management
Workflow Specifications BW-MMS-02 STT rows 1-3; CW-MMS-01 STT row 4

test_cases.workflow_id_name: Registration Management — closed-window guard (Problem Statement)
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: Attempt registration submission while Registration Window is Not Open
test_cases.test_objective: Determine the result of a registration submission outside an open window.
preconditions: No registration window is open.
steps_or_api_action: Student attempts to submit a registration request.
test_cases.expected_result: BLOCKED: the Problem Statement says submissions are allowed only while the window is open but does not define the validation response, request status, or record behavior for this attempt.
test_cases.blocked_reason: The guard is specified, but the expected system outcome on violation is not.
specification_reference: Problem Statement §3.3.1 Registration Management
Workflow Specifications BW-MMS-01 and BW-MMS-02 (valid open-window submission path)

test_cases.workflow_id_name: BW-MMS-03 Deregistration — Approved; CW-MMS-02 Deregistration Request Lifecycle
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: Student Registered -> Deregistration Request Pending -> Deregistration Approved — Awaiting Effective Date -> Student Deregistered / Mess Service Inactive at the next calendar day
test_cases.test_objective: Verify that approval is recorded immediately and service deregistration takes effect only when the next calendar day begins.
preconditions: The student is registered and active in mess service.

test_data.approval_time: A known calendar date and time.
test_data.activation_check: Check after approval on the same calendar day and again when the next calendar day begins.

steps_or_api_action: Student submits a valid deregistration request.
Mess Caretaker approves it.
Check the student's service state before the next calendar day begins.
Allow the next calendar day to begin and check the service state again.
expected_result: The request becomes Pending and then Approved — Awaiting Effective Date.
The student remains registered until the next calendar day begins after approval.
At that trigger, the student becomes Deregistered and mess service becomes Inactive.
MMS triggers the student email notifications for request submission and decision.
specification_reference: Problem Statement §3.3.1 Registration Management
Workflow Specifications BW-MMS-03 STT rows 1-3; CW-MMS-02 STT rows 1-3

steps_or_api_action: Student submits a deregistration request.

test_cases.workflow_id_name: BW-MMS-05 Rebate — Approved as Submitted; CW-MMS-03 Rebate Request Lifecycle
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: No Current Rebate Request -> Rebate Request Pending -> Rebate Approved without date modification
test_cases.test_objective: Verify valid rebate requests for all named reason categories and the minimum-duration and lead-time boundaries when approved without date changes.
preconditions: The student has no overlapping rebate request.
The caretaker can review the submitted request.

test_data.duration: Exactly 3 calendar days in each scenario.
test_data.lead_time: Request submitted one calendar day before the start date.
test_data.dates: Non-overlapping dates with complete reason/date data.

steps_or_api_action: Submit each valid rebate scenario.
For each resulting Pending request, have the Mess Caretaker approve without changing dates.
expected_result: Each valid submission becomes Pending.
Each approved request becomes Approved with submitted dates unchanged, and those approved dates are used for monthly billing adjustment.
MMS triggers student email notifications for each submission and decision.
specification_reference: Problem Statement §3.3.5 Rebate Management
Workflow Specifications BW-MMS-05 STT rows 1-2; CW-MMS-03 STT rows 1-2

test_cases.test_objective: Verify the date-modification-and-approval path and that the modified approved dates drive billing adjustment.
preconditions: A valid rebate request is Pending.

test_data.modified_dates: Not specifiable until the institution's policy-permitted modification rules are supplied.

steps_or_api_action: Have Mess Caretaker modify the pending request dates and approve it, using a modification permitted by institution policy.
test_cases.expected_result: BLOCKED: the specification does not define which date modifications are permitted, so a valid modified-date test input and its expected billing dates cannot be reliably determined.
test_cases.blocked_reason: The workflow is conditional on external policy, whose permitted date changes are not specified.
specification_reference: Problem Statement §3.3.5 Rebate Management
Workflow Specifications BW-MMS-06 STT row 2; CW-MMS-03 STT row 3

test_cases.workflow_id_name: BW-MMS-08 Vacation Survey — Yes Response; CW-MMS-04 Vacation Food Continuity Response Lifecycle
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: Vacation Survey Not Created -> Vacation Survey Open -> Vacation Response = Yes
test_cases.test_objective: Verify survey creation, registered-student inclusion, and an explicit Yes response before the deadline.
preconditions: At least one student is currently registered and one student is not currently registered.
An upcoming institute vacation is identified.

test_data.response_deadline: A future deadline set by the Mess Caretaker.

steps_or_api_action: Mess Caretaker creates the vacation food continuity survey with a response deadline.
Inspect the survey recipient set.
The registered student responds Yes before the deadline.
expected_result: The survey opens and includes currently registered students only; the unregistered student is not included.
The registered student's response is recorded as Yes.
MMS triggers the vacation survey creation email notification.
specification_reference: Problem Statement §3.3.6 Vacation Food Continuity Management and §3.3.10 Notifications
Workflow Specifications BW-MMS-08 STT rows 1-2; CW-MMS-04 STT rows 1-2

test_cases.test_objective: Verify that an explicit No response before the deadline is recorded as No.
preconditions: A vacation survey is open for a currently registered student.
steps_or_api_action: Student submits No before the response deadline.
test_cases.expected_result: The student's vacation response is recorded as No; it is not the system's default-No outcome.

test_cases.workflow_id_name: BW-MMS-10 Vacation Survey — Default No; CW-MMS-04 Vacation Food Continuity Response Lifecycle
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: Vacation Survey Open -> response deadline reached without response -> Vacation Response = Default No
test_cases.test_objective: Verify the system applies the specified default No for a non-responding student when the response deadline is reached.
preconditions: A vacation survey is open for a currently registered student.
The student has no recorded response.

test_data.response_deadline: A specific deadline configured by the Caretaker.

Inspect the student's recorded response.

test_cases.workflow_id_name: Vacation Survey — response exactly at deadline
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: Attempt explicit Yes or No at the exact response deadline
test_cases.test_objective: Determine whether an explicit response at the deadline is accepted or defaulted.
preconditions: A vacation survey is open and a registered student has not yet responded.
steps_or_api_action: Submit an explicit Yes or No at the exact response deadline and inspect the resulting response.
test_cases.expected_result: BLOCKED: explicit responses are specified as occurring before the deadline, while the system applies Default No when the deadline is reached; ordering/acceptance at the exact instant is not defined.
test_cases.blocked_reason: The exact-deadline precedence between user response and system default is unspecified.

test_cases.workflow_id_name: BW-MMS-12 Special Food — Default Rejected; CW-MMS-05 Special Food Request Lifecycle
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: Requested -> institution-defined decision period expires undecided -> Rejected (Default)
test_cases.test_objective: Verify that an undecided request becomes Rejected by default when its stipulated decision period expires.
preconditions: A valid special-food request remains Requested without a Caretaker decision.

test_data.stipulated_decision_period: Exact value unavailable; Problem Statement identifies 12 hours as intended but says the policy value is institution-defined.

steps_or_api_action: Allow the stipulated decision period to expire without a decision.
Inspect the request status and student notification.
test_cases.expected_result: BLOCKED: default rejection is specified, but the institution-defined decision-period value is not supplied, preventing a reliable timeout test setup.
test_cases.blocked_reason: The exact configured decision period is necessary to set a deterministic test deadline; 12 hours is expressly only the intended value.
specification_reference: Problem Statement §3.3.7 Special Food Arrangement and §3.3.10 Notifications
Workflow Specifications BW-MMS-12 STT row 2; CW-MMS-05 STT row 3

test_cases.workflow_id_name: BW-MMS-16 Monthly Billing — Generated to Published
test_cases.workflow_path_transition: Monthly Bill Not Generated -> Monthly Bill Generated -> Monthly Bill Published
test_cases.test_objective: Verify calendar-month bill generation followed by Caretaker review, finalization, and publication; verify a student can view the published bill.
preconditions: The calendar-month billing event is due.
Required billing inputs are available.
A student has a bill for the month.

test_data.billing_inputs: Available served-day, approved special-meal/add-on, approved rebate, and daily-rate inputs.
test_data.bill_review: Caretaker reviews and finalizes generated bills before publication.

steps_or_api_action: Allow the calendar-month billing event to generate bills.
Mess Caretaker reviews, finalizes, and publishes the generated bill.
Student views the published monthly bill and outstanding balance.
expected_result: A monthly bill is generated and then published only after Caretaker review and finalization.
The student can view the published bill and outstanding balance.
MMS triggers the monthly bill publication email notification.
specification_reference: Problem Statement §3.3.3 Billing Management and §3.3.10 Notifications
Workflow Specifications BW-MMS-16 STT rows 1-2
